text: aboutAddressBookCommands.mjs imports MailServices into its module scope but uses explicitly listed globals supplied by the Address Book document script. The globals comment is a lint declaration, not runtime initialization. The document loads the classic script and command module as separate script roles. Keep this scoped workaround separate from normal import choices; its comment says import-globals-from is intended but the linter rejects it. No linter or document runtime test ran.
title: Address Book command module imports MailServices but borrows document globals
